decision: Remove optional vendor SDK import and keep strict normalization behavior in a pure module.

R-module-boundary.text: The domain normalization module must use only Python standard library. Remove vendor telemetry/network import dependencies while preserving normalize(name, enabled): name must be string, trim and casefold; enabled must be a genuine bool; invalid values raise ValueError; output is {name, enabled}. No telemetry side effect belongs in domain normalization.

I-module-boundary.text: Synthetic import incident: a domain module could not load when optional vendor SDK was absent. An apparent fix silently coerced strings such as "false" to true.

L-module-boundary.text: Synthetic import incident: a domain module could not load when optional vendor SDK was absent. An apparent fix silently coerced strings such as "false" to true.

T-module-boundary.text: raw record -> validated domain record; invalid input -> ValueError with no telemetry calls.
